Author: ArbiEver Bot
Message:
Phase 5/6/7 infrastructure + type-2 reaper workaround

Phase 5 (DAC):
- BLS keypair generated, daserver running (RPC :9876, REST :9877)
- Keyset registered on L1 SequencerInbox (hash: 0xab2df6c8ae...)

Phase 6 (Batch Poster):
- Nitro batch-poster enabled with separate key
- RPC aggregator configured with DAC backend

Phase 7 (Validator):
- ValidatorWallet contract: 0xf7Ce8D84B8b9BAfa70E44F2087BA682fE88D0500
- Whitelisted on RollupAdmin
- Nitro staker (MakeNodes, without-block-validator)

Known constraint:
- EtherEver miner doesn't include EIP-1559 type-2 txs
- Nitro v3.2.1 dataposter always uses type-2 when L1 reports baseFee
- We need baseFee for sequencer's updateExpectedSurplus (else panic)
- Conflict resolved by: keep injecting baseFee + reaper service that
  periodically replaces stuck type-2 with legacy zero-transfer

Effect:
- L2 sequencer, deposits, transactions: all working
- Batch propagation to L1, validator assertions: blocked at L1 mining

See arbiPhase567_status.md for complete analysis and resolution paths.

Added:
- reaper.py + arbiever-reaper.service (type-2 cleaner)
- node_config.json.example (sanitized template)
- systemd/arbiever-reaper.service
